findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is an uninstantiable abstract class
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` was changed to subclass `StatefulDetectorHandler[QuerySubscriptionUpdate]` with a `pass` body, without implementing any of `StatefulDetectorHandler`'s abstract methods (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Previously it implemented `DetectorHandler.evaluate` and could be instantiated. Now, accessing `detector.detector_handler` on any `Detector` whose `type` is `"metric_alert_fire"` will call `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(self)` (in `Detector.detector_handler` at `src/sentry/workflow_engine/models/detector.py:86`) and raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler with abstract methods ...` at runtime.
